LESSON: PATTERN WRITING

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.5: Pattern Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Pattern Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Use ICT devices to make simple line patterns. 3.

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: PATTERN WRITING
Pattern Writing is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Pattern Writing problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Pattern Writing question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Pattern Writing question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Pattern Writing set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Pattern Writing.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Pattern Writing in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use ICT devices to make simple line patterns. 3.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
